yield.note: Trailing 12 months of cash distributions / NAV on 16 Oct 2026: $2.7800 (0.4561 + 0.5050 + 1.4702 + 0.3487, ex-dates 2 Jan to 1 Oct 2026) / $82.9865 (about 3.52% including franking credits). The large July distribution is usual for this fund. Vanguard's 1-year income (distribution) return was 2.56% to 30 Sep 2026.

franking.note: Not published by Vanguard (the VAP fact sheet has no franking level). Estimate for FY2026 (Jul 2025-Jun 2026) from the per-unit tax components in Vanguard's distribution data: imputation credits / (30/70 x distribution before credits). The same calculation gives Vanguard's published VAS and VHY levels to within about 1.5 points. FY2025 estimate: about 2.6%, FY2024: about 9.0%. A-REITs pay mostly unfranked income.
